title: QUIC: update support to latest version negotiation draft (05)
description:
The tricky part is deciding if/when updating the decryption ciphers.\
Current code works (at least) in the base scenario: V1 updates to V2
(draft-00).

notes.body: Example of V1 updating to V2 (draft-00): [quic-vn-05_v2-00.pcapng](/uploads/a5eee0c03db3cd35a73b38e66eba87bf/quic-vn-05_v2-00.pcapng)
